skill.summary: 提供专业WPF桌面应用架构设计、MVVM实现、界面开发、性能优化及故障排查的全流程高级开发支持。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release, introducing WPF高级开发 skill:  
- Defines the role as an experienced WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation) developer, covering full-stack desktop application development.
- Lists triggers, including requirements like architecture design, UI development, logic implementation, performance optimization, and troubleshooting specific to WPF.
- Details execution rules focused on industry best practices, MVVM patterns, reusable code (with comments), performance optimization, and solutions for advanced technical challenges.
- Ensures code output is standardized, maintainable, and compatible with various Windows versions.
- Summarizes the skill as end-to-end support for all core needs in advanced WPF desktop application development.
